g.text: Optional jobs, chosen at bundle init
daily_rollout: daily traffic stages, can start serving_endpoint
online_publication: publish a feature table to an online store
online_feature_lookup_setup: endpoint that looks up features online
Shown: single_model with prediction_delivery both. Dashed arrows are conditional runs.
batch has no serving_endpoint job; endpoint has no score job.
model_competition and multi_target change the tasks inside these jobs, not the jobs.
